user.title: Set up Kalkotronic
user.description: The wifi parameters are used to automatically restore the connection if the module falls back to configuration mode. SSID, password and gateway are all required to enable recovery.

error.invalid_ip: Invalid IP address. Enter an IPv4 address such as 192.168.1.x
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device. Check that it is powered on and reachable.
error.invalid_gateway: Invalid gateway. Enter an IPv4 address such as 192.168.1.x
error.incomplete_wifi: Automatic wifi recovery requires SSID, password and gateway together.

init.title: Automatic wifi recovery
init.description: SSID, password and gateway are required to enable recovery. Leave everything empty to disable it.

error.invalid_gateway: Invalid gateway. Enter an IPv4 address such as 192.168.1.x
error.incomplete_wifi: Automatic wifi recovery requires SSID, password and gateway together.

update_datetime.name: Synchronize date and time
update_datetime.description: Sets the Home Assistant date and time on the Kalkotronic device (the device does not support NTP).
